description: (NaCO₂)₄H₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12 space group. The structure consists of two H₂ clusters inside a NaCO₂ framework. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaCO₂ framework, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.88 Å. C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four equivalent Na and one C atom.
